title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is finally here. Hoping to make it a perfect finale, Fine Motion swears to put on a performance that will remain in the hearts of everyone who watches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Do you have the determination to face the Empress on this honorable stage?" Air Groove asks. Fine Motion smiles back at her. "Of course."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An esteemed and momentous stage is set for the rematch they've longed for. The battle begins now!
